newsitem.title: USA: U.S. continues to seek IMF gold sales, Rubin says.
newsitem.headline: U.S. continues to seek IMF gold sales, Rubin says.

text.p: The United States is continuing to work toward an agreement on International Monetary Fund gold sales, but is not clear when a pact can be reached, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Thursday.
"We continue to work toward that end," he told reporters after a speech to the President's Export Council. "Whether that will get done in the near future or not, I do not know."
The IMF on Wednesday endorsed stepped-up aid for the world's poorest nations, including debt relief. But it stopped short of spelling out how it planned to pay for that.
Rubin said that the United States believes that gold sales will be needed "in the final analysis" to provide that increased assistance.
"The real question, in our judgement, is when it's going to get done," he said. "And I really don't have the answer to that."
